Issued FY2027 outlook implying ~27% revenue growth and ~24% non-GAAP diluted EPS growth at the midpoint, citing AI/data-center demand.

Sanmina reports Q4 and fiscal 2026 results: non-GAAP EPS $4.43 (vs $3.27 est.), revenue $3.86B (vs $3.48B est.); FY2026 revenue $14.53B (+79% YoY) driven by ZT Systems acquisition; cloud/AI infrastructure revenue +179% YoY to $2.37B in Q4

catalysts.headline: Sanmina reports Q4 and full-year FY2026 results: Q4 revenue ~$3.86-3.9B (+84% YoY) on the ZT Systems acquisition, non-GAAP diluted EPS $4.43, GAAP diluted EPS $2.14; FY2026 revenue a record $14.53B (+79% YoY), GAAP diluted EPS $6.85, non-GAAP EPS $13.28, full-year GAAP operating margin 4.7%; issues FY2027 guidance of $17.5-19.5B revenue and $15.50-17.50 non-GAAP EPS, with Q1 FY2027 revenue guided to $3.8-4.1B
